name: cursor-pager
title: Cursor Pager
description: Previous and Next for keyset (cursor) paging — a range label and two buttons, with no page numbers and no total.

meta.whenToUse: Keyset-paged lists that page instead of scroll — DataGrid's pagedMode, or any host that keeps a cursor history and knows only whether a previous and a next page exist.
meta.whenNotToUse: Lists with a total and page numbers (DataListPager), or continuous paging on scroll (LoadMore).
